author: Learn Linux TV
description:
In this video, I take a full look at the Fedora 44 COSMIC spin — Fedora's official release of the COSMIC Desktop Environment. I cover a first look at the interface, a bit of the history behind COSMIC, its standout auto-tiling feature, and why I made the switch to Fedora COSMIC as my daily driver. If you're curious whether Fedora COSMIC is worth using in 2026, this review breaks it down for you.
